title: Course management back office
titleZh: 冰草约课 · 课程管理后台
summary: A realistic course-management back office for a yoga studio. The assistant carries a guided course task in chat, understands a whole description through working memory, validates it against the page, and writes through the same executor as chat.
summaryZh: 冰草约课的门店课程管理后台：助手在聊天里承接引导任务，基于工作记忆理解整段描述，由页面校验后通过与聊天相同的执行器完成写入。

guide.title: A task is a contract, not a second app
guide.titleZh: 任务是一份契约，不是第二套应用
intro: This page already has students, membership cards, teachers, and a schedule. The guide does not reimplement any of those rules. It sits in the chat, lets the model understand what the person supplied, and calls the existing business actions in order.
The same task runtime will be used by the Vue, React, Vue 2.7, and Vanilla versions. Only the page rendering changes.
introZh: 这个页面本来就有学员、会员卡、老师和课表。引导没有重写任何一条业务规则；它留在聊天里，让模型理解用户提供的信息，再按顺序调用已有的业务动作。
后面的 Vue、React、Vue 2.7 与原生 JS 版本会共用同一套任务运行时，变化的只有页面渲染。

steps.title: Start with the business service
steps.body: Searching students, reading cards, adding a teacher, checking a slot, and creating a lesson all live in one service. The interface and the task layer call these functions; neither owns a private copy of the rules.
steps.bodyZh: 搜索学员、读取会员卡、新增老师、检查时段与创建课程都在同一个服务里。界面和任务层调用这些函数，谁都不会私存一份规则。

steps.title: Describe the task once
steps.body: A task names its fields and ordered steps. The course task collects the catalogue fields in the chat, while the scheduling task reuses a lookup field so the two students called Li Na can be told apart by masked phone number.
steps.bodyZh: 任务只声明字段与步骤顺序。新建课程任务在聊天里收集课程库字段；排课任务复用查找字段，让两个都叫李娜的学员可以靠脱敏手机号区分。

steps.title: Reuse the existing executor
steps.body: The task controller receives one invoke bridge. Here it is the same executor the assistant uses, so action ids, availability, audit, and future approval rules stay on one path.
steps.bodyZh: 任务控制器只接收一个 invoke 桥。这里接的是助手原本使用的同一个执行器，因此动作 id、可用性、审计以及未来的确认规则都留在同一条路径上。

steps.title: Put the task in the conversation
steps.body: The view mounts the shared task controller in the chat transcript and switches to the guide action row while the course task is active. Task decisions and ordinary messages share one assistant surface; there is no second form or field rail.
steps.bodyZh: 视图把共享任务控制器挂进聊天消息流，课程任务激活时切换成引导操作行。任务决定和普通消息共用一个助手入口，没有第二套表单或字段轨道。

steps.title: Keep the free-form assistant available
steps.body: The fused sidebar keeps the page and the assistant visible together. Guided tasks cover common operations; the composer still handles questions and unusual requests. Open Activity and Debug to see the model request, tool arguments, and page evidence.
steps.bodyZh: 融合侧栏让页面和助手同时可见。引导任务覆盖常用操作，输入框仍负责提问和特殊请求。打开“最近操作”与调试，可以看到模型请求、工具参数与页面证据。

guide.note: Describe a course in one sentence, upload the cover yourself, review, and confirm. Then add a teacher or schedule a lesson. To see a rejected step, schedule Zhou Min on 2026-03-16 at 10:00, where a lesson already exists.
guide.noteZh: 先用一句话描述课程，自己上传封面，再核对并确认。之后可以新增老师或安排课程。要看不通过的一步，可以给周敏排 2026-03-16 10:00，这个时段已经有课。
